meta_title: TFP The Female Plumber | Plumbing & Renovations Derby
meta_description: TFP The Female Plumber & Renovations Ltd in Derby. Emergency plumbing, boiler repairs, and full renovation services. Fast response times, fair pricing. Call today.
hero_subhead: Burst pipes, boiler breakdowns, and full renovations. We're here fast, work fairly, and finish on time.
services_heading: Complete Plumbing & Renovation Services Across Derby
services_subhead: From emergency repairs to full bathroom and kitchen renovations, we handle every aspect of your home's plumbing and build work.

services.title: Emergency Plumbing Repairs
services.desc: Burst pipes, leaks, and blockages fixed fast. We're on call 24/7 and carry parts on the van — most jobs sorted same day.

services.title: Boiler Installation & Repair
services.desc: New boiler installation, repairs, and servicing. We fit industry-leading brands and guarantee warmth through winter.

services.title: Bathroom Renovations
services.desc: Complete bathroom redesign and installation. Tiling, fixtures, plumbing — we manage the whole project from start to finish.

services.title: Kitchen Installation
services.desc: New kitchens and kitchen plumbing work. Fitted units, appliance connections, and waste management — done right, on budget.

services.title: Central Heating Systems
services.desc: Radiator installation, pipework upgrades, and heating system repairs. We improve efficiency and reduce your energy bills.

services.title: Wet Rooms & Showers
services.desc: Specialist wet room design, waterproofing, and installation. Safe, stylish, and built to last.

about_pullquote: I started this business because I was tired of seeing cowboys rip people off.
about_para_1: TFP The Female Plumber & Renovations was founded on a simple idea: bring honesty, skill, and fair pricing back to the trades. With over a decade of hands-on experience in Derby and the surrounding areas, we've built our reputation on turning up on time, doing the job properly, and never cutting corners.
about_para_2: Our customers trust us because we listen. Whether it's an emergency at midnight or a six-month renovation project, we treat your home with the same care we'd give our own. We finish what we start, keep disruption to a minimum, and stand behind our work.
reviews_heading: What Derby Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Called TFP at 11pm with a burst pipe flooding the kitchen. She arrived by 12:15am, turned off the water, and had it repaired by 1:30am. Professional, calm, and didn't take the mickey on the price. Lifesaver. Won't use anyone else.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: Had our entire bathroom done. From the first visit to the final tile, everything was on schedule and on budget. Sarah explained what she was doing at every step. Brilliant workmanship and such a breath of fresh air dealing with a woman in the trades.
reviews.author: Emma L.

reviews.text: Boiler packed in during that cold snap. Got through straight away, she came out same morning, sorted it in a couple of hours. Honest quote, no pressure, no faffing about. This is exactly what local tradespeople should be like.
reviews.author: David H.
